integrity: The proof derives the three cardinal basis functions explicitly from the natural-spline equations and optimizes their unique negative coefficient analytically. The packaged checker independently replays the algebraic identities and representative exact-rational spline evaluations; finite checks are corroborative, not the proof of the all-mesh statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is exact for the ordinary natural cubic interpolant through exactly three knots. It does not classify longer grids, other cubic boundary conditions, or shape-preserving modifications. The full text of the closest 1991 positivity paper was not recovered, leaving a residual originality risk for an equivalent three-node calculation.
title: A sharp three-knot positivity defect for natural cubic interpolation
